description.value:
At 1st level, you select a programming language that you use to store, manipulate, and hack your spells.

Spell Cache: Your programming language indicates which spells are automatically added to your spell cache.

Magic Hacks: Magic hacks are a type of focus spell that appear on pages 162–163. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to scroll through your spell database or conduct arcane research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Certain feats give you more focus spells. The maximum Focus Points your focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus spells you have, but it can never be more than 3 points.

At 1st level, you learn the initial magic hack, which is unique to your programming language. You can learn the advanced magic hack with the Advanced Magic Hack feat and the greater magic hack with the Greater Magic Hack feat.

Spellshape: Your programming language grants you innovative ways to manipulate magic. You gain the listed spellshape feat at 1st level.

Firmware Enhancement: You've enhanced your equipment with firmware to suit your needs. You gain the listed firmware enhancement at 1st level.

Overclock Boost: Each programming language is associated with a type of item, noted in the overclock boost entry. You can only overclock items that match your programming language's item type. When you're holding, wearing, or wielding an overclocked item, or when you have an overclocked minion, you gain the benefits of the overclock boost.

Overclock Pulse: Each programming language grants you a unique, powerful effect that you can invoke to draw out the full potential of your overclocked gear.

Jailbreak: Starting at 3rd level, when you use Jailbreak Spell and apply your programming language's preferred spellshape, you can additionally choose to gain the benefits listed in the jailbreak entry.

At 8th level, you gain the advanced jailbreak benefit from your programming language; the Jailbreak Spell action allows you to apply one jailbreak effect of your choice, but not both.
